描述_ZN: Yao Xie's Poetic Intentions, Qing Dynasty, painted by Ren Xiong, on silk with color, each opening 27.3 cm in length and 32.5 cm in width.　　This set consists of ten volumes, each with twelve openings, each of which, in addition to Yao Xie's poems, also bears the seal of "Xiong" in vermilion or "Wei Chang" in white. At the end of the booklet, there are four other openings with inscriptions by Ren Xiong, Xiong Songzhi, Wu Yun, Shen Yu, Cao Rui, Li Hongdi and others. According to Ren Xiong's own postscript, the work was completed in the first year of Xianfeng (1851), at the age of 29.　　This set of one hundred and twenty pages was painted by Ren Xiong when he was living in the house of his friend Yao Xie. Yao Xie, the character Mei Bo, the number Fuzhuang, was a native of Zhenhai, Zhejiang Province. He was a scholar during the Daoguang period and was known for his poetry. This book is decorated with Yao Xie's poems and has a wide variety of subjects, including figures and ghosts, flowers, birds, fish and insects, pavilions and pavilions, and the wind and moon are all gathered in the frame. The whole book is unique, often with divine brushstrokes; the coloring is ancient and elegant in the brightness, which can be regarded as Ren's masterpiece at the peak. The contents of the first volume are as follows: The first volume: "Overlooking the Dragon Abyss, Planting Sun Trees in the Flower Field", with the inscription of "Xiong" (square seal in vermilion).　　Inscription of "Wei Chang" (square seal in white).　　The third opening: "Newly planted pear blossoms fill the fan lake", inscription of "Wei Chang" (square seal in white).　　Fourth opening: "The fruit is set out for display, and the fruit is opened in the preserved year", with the inscription "Wei Chang" (square seal in white).　　The fifth opening: "The white ape is like an old man, riding a three-legged turtle upside down", inscription of "Xiong" (square seal in vermilion).　　Sixth Openings: "The House of Sheep in the Disorderly Wood of Pinggang", Inscription of "Xiong" (square seal in vermilion).　　The seventh opening: "The flowers are cold and bitter when complaining about autumn, but they are like the spring maids in the list of repair", with the inscription of "Xiong" (square seal in vermilion).　　Eighth opening: "There is a whale in the lower part of the wave, and a falcon in the upper part of the sky", with the inscription of "Xiong" (square seal in vermilion).　　Ninth opening: "The red medicine is languid and the green apricot is pregnant", inscription of "Xiong" (square seal in vermilion).　　The tenth opening: "Sister Kunlun of the Tang Dynasty, White Snow Nun of the Yu Family", inscription "Xiong" (square seal in vermilion).　　Eleventh openings: "Xiong Qi Qi Beast Premieres", inscription "Wei Chang" (square seal in white).　　The twelfth opening: "Yao Wei Tianzhu Yan Luo Zhong", inscription "Wei Chang" (square seal in white).
